pages: I see...
So that's why Mizuki's first attack was aimed from Oki toward Izumo,
and why the place she slept was Mount Osore...
There was a whole history behind it all!
Mizuki sowed the seeds of calamity all over the world for the Dark Lord.
With Agou, Ungou and other demons at her command,
she absorbed the fear and despair of the people
and spread nightmares and curses far and wide...
But because she is immortal,
Mizuki must take over the bodies of others to act.
When that body decays, she has no choice but to limit her activity...
Unable to find a body to her liking, Mizuki
decided to go dormant...
She ordered Agou to build the Demon Fortress, and Ungou the Animus Bell,
and went to sleep on Mount Osore herself...
And that's when Lady Bizuki went to defeat her, right?
Indeed...
As you know, Lady Bizuki was struck down by Mizuki,
and what's worse, her body was taken over...
After that, this Kuroko and I challenged her,
and got beaten without landing a single blow, just
as I described in the main story...
Wow... so the world very nearly
fell into the hands of the Dark Lord...
Indeed... it was a truly close call!
But as long as darkness lives in men's hearts, the Dark Lord can't be destroyed.
A second or third Amakusa or Mizuki will surely appear in the future.
In the end, perhaps the power to defeat evil lies not in the sword,
but in the righteousness of the human heart...
Well, now that everything's wrapped up,
it's finally time to say goodbye...
And now, the special corner you've all been waiting for!
Kuroko's Secret Intelligence Bureau!
This familiar corner takes the tips and tattles you send us,
and spills the beans, true or not!
It's a terrifying corner indeed!
Today, our special guest Master Nicotine will be sharing the scoop!
Hm... very well, then.
For all the good kids out there playing on the Sega Saturn,
I shall present a rather adult picture of Nakoruru!
Wh-what did you say?
A racy illustration so hot that the character designer Shiro Ohno
himself got a nosebleed...
Then SNK's top-class graphic artists spent an entire year
turning it into pixel art... a labor of love!
It was so racy that it got shelved for good,
a graphic with quite a story behind it!
I-if that's true, it's a real scoop!
W-well then, let's have a look right away...
Lights off, please...
Haohmaru! This time, your life is mine!
Now, fight me!
Dammit, fine then! Here I come!
Come on!
Enough! Stooooop iiiiiit!
And so, we're out of time!
Ah, what a shame about Nakoruru's racy graphic!
Still buzzing with excitement, from the item shop in south Edo...
Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye!
...Bushido Retsuden.
Thank you so much for playing to the very end!
Please be sure to try the other heroes too!
Until then! Farewell!
Ohhhh... what a pity...
Have hundreds and thousands of days been lost once more to time?
...When will a hero worthy of our Atlantean wish
finally come to this place?
...Lamenting changes nothing.
We shall wait again... hundreds and thousands of days...
HEY, don't worry! Relax!
I'm Galford, the ninja of justice!
It's okay! If any bad guys show up, I'll take care of them!
...So, what happened?
Tell me if you'd like. I'll help you out!
What a noisy fool...
Perhaps I should just put you out of your misery myself!
How about it? You'd never have to be scared
again!
Hey, hey... Genjuro!
Hmph... if you value your life, at least tell us what happened!
Preparations for the great European counteroffensive are going smoothly...
We leave Peking in your hands!
Oh, it's you... Let me heal you!
Thanks to the kindness of Queen Antoinette of France,
knights from all over Europe are gathering in Paris...
With such a great army, even St. Germain
won't be able to do as he pleases anymore...
This is the Izumo Gate...
This is the Aso Gate...
This is the Peking Gate...
This is the Paris Gate...
This is the South America Gate...
This is the San Francisco Gate...
This is the Kyoto Gate...
This is the Mount Osore Gate...
The grudge of the Muu... is moo-ving right here!
Let's use the key we got from Holly.
Hold it!
Are you the one who calls himself King of Hell?
Tell me, where is Mizuki!
You there...
Ahead lies a road that leads to Kyoto. Take care!
Japan now... faces a time of great crisis!
Kekeke! What weaklings you are!
At this rate, you'll never make it any further! Kekeke!
Don't worry! I'll finish you off right here!
You won't have to think about the future anymore! Nkekekekeke!
...You disappoint me... powerless heroes...
But I shall blame you no further.
For you too are friends of the fallen ancient city of Shambhala.
Now... the time of rest has come. Go to sleep...
You need not fight anymore...
Until the day a true hero worthy of my power arrives...
Hey, Tam Tam!
Thanks for saving my old man!
I heard you beat three demons in the blink of an eye!
He was amazed, said you really are the best warrior in the village!
Thanks so much!
Granted by Lord Quetzalcoatl...
the holy Palenque Stone...
Tam Tam protect it... warrior's duty!
Hey, Tam Tam... I need to talk to you about something...
What?
Cham Cham, where'd Tam Tam go?
There was a flash of light over by the god statue, and then nothing.
Without Tam Tam around at a time like this, I feel kind of uneasy.
Cham Chaaam!
Yay! Let's play, Chona Chona!
Have you already been to the sun temple on Mount Halehale?
Quit playing with Chona Chona all the time
and do a proper job filling in for Tam Tam.
Or what's wrong, Cham Cham?
3015.question: Are you tired?

pages: Who there!?
Such thing... warrior Tam Tam not allow!
Ugh! ...W-wait!
...Oh... what have I done...
To my god Lord Quetzalcoatl, and everyone in village...
what can I say!?
Oh! The voice of Lord Quetzalcoatl!?
Please, forgive...
Tam Tam get it back, even if cost life!
Ugh... Waaaaaaargh!
Cham Chaaam...
Onjii said when you go out,
you should take medicinal herbs.
Sorry, Chona Chona...
Me gotta go to the north temple instead of big bro Tam,
on errand for Onjii...
Okay... then let's play again after your errand!
But Cham Cham... it's dangerous outside...
You should take lotsa herbs with you...
Thanks, Chona Chona!
Wait for me! Me finish errand super quick!
Come back soon, okay?
Cham Cham, when your errand's done, let's play together again!
Ohhhh! So close! Really close... yes!
Super Green Juice, we no have now! So close!
Chance to taste grown-up flavor... you missed!
The holy Palenque Stone...
This mysterious, glittering stone came to be worshipped by the villagers,
who offered prayers to it every single day...
Neither feuds between tribes,
nor the invasion of white barbarians bearing fire-spitting spears,
ever disturbed the peace of that village.
The people believed the holy stone that guarded their village
was a gift from the sun god Quetzalcoatl,
and treasured it dearly as the village's greatest treasure...
Greenhell, South America... Under the protection of the Palenque Stone,
the people enjoyed cheerful, peaceful lives in this village.
But the peace of this hidden paradise was about to be shattered...
The evil hand of darkness, the fangs of demons dwelling in shadow,
had at last reached even Greenhell.
Good work, Tam Tam! Patrolling the village again today?
Tam Tam!
Your little sister Cham Cham is always so full of energy!
...Too much energy. It trouble me.
What are you saying! Being lively is a good thing!
...Normally, that so, but...
Protect everyone in village! That Tam Tam's job!
Come by my house sometime! I'll treat you to dinner!
My old man wants to thank you too!
Thank you... I come, for sure.
Wh... what magic power! Cannot even... get close!
Whaddaya want!
Anything else you need?
Come again!
This oughta be enough for you.
This person, then?
How much should I work on it?
Nyao! All done!
Anything else you need?
Which one'll it be?
Nobody can equip that!
Gonna equip it?
Who's gonna equip it?
Th-th-thank you!
You've got nothing to sell!
Is that okay?
That is the nature of legends...
People find truth in their very confusion and contradictions.
Please, rest well...
I see. Do come again, don't be shy.
Ohhh... why, if it isn't Cham Cham!
Are you all right? The mountain spirits have turned into demons,
even this close to the temple...
Raaaaagh!
I'll protect my old lady!
Hm? Why, it's just Cham Cham.
You have business at the temple too?
The sun temple is just up those stone steps there.
Hey, Cham Cham, are you okay?
The spirits have gone wild... What the heck is going on?
Just above here is the jungle exit, but the temple's a bit farther.
I don't know what your errand is, but you'd better turn back.
Yay! Me did it!
......A woman?
Hmph... she's no ordinary vixen, it seems.
And... Sieger too...
Ah! Sieger!
! Sieger!
Reooooon!
Farewell! Siegerrrr!
Oh my, finished already? Ahaha!
Lady Mizuki! I've disposed of the foolish humans!
Please take the two orbs into your hands! Eternal darkness to this world!
And to your humble Xibalba, your eternal blessing! Haha!
I must surpass my father...
I must surpass my father, the great ninja Hattori Hanzo...
And for that... there is only training!
Only training...
Heh heh heh...
...Is your father's fame such a heavy burden?
So you want power?
Power... like your father's?
Heh heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh...
I see... so you want it...
I see! Power!
Power!
POWER!
S-stop it!
What are you doing!
Surpassing your father is child's play!
I shall lend you my power!
Your body shall become my body!
YEAH! Thank you, Hattori Hanzo!
To become a great ninja like you,
I came all the way from America to Japan!
To have the great Hanzo I admire teach me ninjutsu...
I'm one lucky guy!
Indeed... you all have plenty of potential.
If you devote yourselves to training here on Tsukiyama, you'll grow even stronger.
(Yeah, yeah, whatever you say.)
(What a drag, seriously...)
Wh-what!
NO!
Hmm... And this smell? Humans?
Now then... allow me to lend a hand!
It's not only Master Nicotine...
Embarrassing as it is, for me, Kuroko, as well,
this is a place I can never forget...
And Mizuki!
{NAME}... I pray for your success in battle...
Count them yourselves! The souls that died at your hands!
The cries of the demons' souls! Taste them and die!
...I've been waiting...
...Unbelievable! Rakiki!
But... wonderful! Your power! Your souls!
They have grown even greater! Rakikikikiki!
Worthy of being offered to my god!
Behold!
And despair!
We... are... Aungou!
Forgive my rudeness before the final battle!
Please... grant this Kuroko a moment of your time!
It's not only Master Nicotine...
Embarrassing as it is, for me, Kuroko, as well,
this is a place I can never forget...
And Mizuki!
{NAME}... I pray for your success in battle...
The pact of a thousand years...
I shall fulfill it now!
I am Mizuki! This world shall walk the path of ruin!
Nakoruru!
Ukyo!
Curse you... curse you...! CUUURSE... CURSE YOU!
GGGYARRRR!!
What!?
Why, it's Shikuruu!
How did you know I'd come here?
Of course, Kamuy Kotan is right in front of us...
Did you find me all the way from Kamuy Kotan?
Hehe... thank you, as always.
Sorry, Mamahaha.
I'll try a little longer with Shikuruu.
This charm works wonders! It'll come in handy for sure!
What a shame...
You might regret it... Uhehehe...
...Hion...
RYAKYYY! Yes! That's what makes this fun!
Your shining souls... I'll make them my flesh and blood!
Haon!!
Haon?
Haoooon!
...Nakoruru...
...Ukyo...
...Hope... for the next life...
OH... Jesus...
RAKYYYYY!
Foolish humans who disturbed my slumber...
...How do pain, despair and curses taste? RAKKKY!!
I would have liked to sleep a bit longer, but very well...
Since you went to the trouble of waking me...
I shall paint the world in darkness in this very age!
Rakiraki! Rakikikikiki!
Your pass is in order...! You're not with any shady religion, are you?
...Sorry, sorry. Between you and me,
Yagyu Jubei, who headed to Edo a while ago,
ordered us not to let anyone from the Ambra cult into Edo.
So, are you going through?
3113.question: Pass the Hakone checkpoint?

pages: You there, traveler! You look like a warrior of some renown.
When Lord Wan-Fu returns,
you should have him train you in the dojo upstairs.
You'll be able to grow even stronger!
Ohhh! My brother sure has the devil's own luck!
Use this when you fight! Everyone in Peking knows that, yes?
Don't you look down on it just because it's a toy, you see!
You go in on your own! Not my problem after that, yes?
Hmph... even the big shots care only about themselves, you see.
I can't trust anyone anymore, yes?
I can't believe it... Is the day this gate opens finally near, yes?
Nuhahahahaha!
How about it? As thanks for that time, I'll personally
give you some Wan-Fu style training!
Hmmmm...
But it seems you no longer need any training.
All that's left is to go out and kill demons for real!
If you're up for it, don't hold back!
3123.question: Train?

pages: Wahahahaha! That's the spirit!
Mmmmph! As expected of you, {NAME}!
With this power, Mizuki is no more than a fly buzzing on pig dung!
Splendid! I pray for your safe journey!
Cut off that bastard Mizuki's head for me!
Bah! I'm disappointed it's only this much!
Graaah! You need more strength if you want Mizuki's head!
Hmph... but you lot
have already finished training at the Wan-Fu dojo.
Go cut down demons with those skills and call it training!
Gahahahahaha!
...Nakoruru...
...Ukyo...
...Cham Cham...
Training at the dojo is a one-time thing.
Now go test those skills in real battle.
What you need, yes?
Anything else, yes?
Leave it to me any time, you see.
This is plenty for you, you see.
Here I go, yes!
Hao! Fine work, you see!
Anything else, yes?
Which one, yes?
Nobody can equip that, you see.
Equip it now, yes?
Who will equip it, yes?
Which one to remove, yes?
Ndoraaaaaaaagh! Too weak!
I'll slit your throats and toss you into the pigsty!
You pig dung!
Gahahahahahaha! Is this the big mouth that was talking big!?
So you never spew such lies again,
I'll crush your skulls!
Dora dora doraaa! You're first!
Oh my... finished already? Surely you jest?
Was I wrong about you, then?
Come... stand up... The feast has only just begun.
The pleasure of death is still too early for you...
Come, entertain me warmly with your souls...
You people are humans, yes?
Aiyaa! That's rare, you see...
It's full of demons in there! Go in and you get eaten, you see!
Take my advice, you better turn back, yes!
3148.question: Heed the gatekeeper's advice?

pages: No demon will eat me, they say I look nasty, you see.
...Happy or sad, I don't know. Complicated feeling, yes.
I see, yes...
The palace is now an invisible maze, thanks to Lady Youkihi's magic.
...You have plenty of herbs and salves, yes?
Aaaah... where is the exit, yes?
I can see the exit right there, so why can't I reach it, you see?
Thank goodness! I'm saved, yes!
When you get back to town, please stop by my smithy, you see!
With swords I forged,
please go beat lots and lots of demons, yes!
Wh-what! I can't believe it...
After he was so good to us!
Not Lord Wan-Fu, of all people...
A-anyway, thank you very much.
Grrgrrgrr... how pathetic... grrr
For now, I'll just devour their souls!
A guy's gotta have some perks, after all... grrgrr...
Foolish humans who defy Lady Youkihi!
Now, I'll tear you limb from limb!
And put you on display in the streets of Peking as a warning!
Garugarugaru!
Grrrr... so you made it this far...
I'll give you credit!
Lady Youkihi herself shall dine on your souls...
How about that? You should be honored! Grrrr...
